title: Coverage Closure Loop: ALU
description: Read a per-plan-row coverage report, classify each hole, and change only the stimulus so the ALU plan closes on three seeds of 500 transactions, with every check passing and no forbidden input.

steps.title: Step 1: Run three seeds and read the report
steps.instructions: Compile alu_pkg.sv, alu.sv and tb_top.sv (top level tb_top) and run with +SEED=1, +SEED=2 and +SEED=3. Copy each run's five COV lines and its COV_SUMMARY line into a table with one row per plan row (ALU-1 to ALU-5). Expect a total near 61% and LAB RESULT: OPEN. Do not change anything yet.

steps.title: Step 2: Classify every short item
steps.instructions: For each item below 100%, decide its class: forbidden, unreachable, under-stimulated or unobserved. Read the constraint block of alu_txn in alu_pkg.sv before deciding. For one cell of x_op_a, compute the chance that 500 transactions hit it with P = 1 - (1 - p)^N. Write the class and your evidence next to each plan row.

steps.title: Step 3: Fix the generator bug
steps.instructions: Make the smallest constraint change that lets every operation be generated. Predict the new total (about 64%), then rerun seeds 1 to 3. Some seeds may now report an ALU-5 error: note it and continue to step 4.

steps.title: Step 4: Steer the rare cells
steps.instructions: Add dist constraints that give BOTH edge values (8'h00 and 8'hFF) of BOTH inputs real weight, for example a dist {8'h00 := 1, 8'hFF := 1, [8'h01:8'hFE] :/ 2};. Predict the per-cell probability of x_op_a and x_op_b before you rerun seeds 1 to 3. Weighting only 8'hFF, or only a, leaves cells rare and stalls well short of 100% (about 82% with only a steered).

steps.title: Step 5: Handle the forbidden input that steering exposed
steps.instructions: Steering b toward 0 makes DIV with b == 0 frequent, so ILLEGAL is no longer 0 and the simulator reports illegal-bin errors. The spec forbids this input (ALU-5). Classify it and fix it in the stimulus, not in the coverage model: ignore_bins would only hide a forbidden scenario. Rerun seeds 1 to 3 until each prints LAB RESULT: CLOSED with FAIL=0 and ILLEGAL=0.

steps.title: Step 6 (optional): Make a hole unobserved on purpose
steps.instructions: In tb_top.sv, move cov.write(t); into the n_fail++ branch so the collector is fed only on failures. Rerun one seed: every check passes, yet every COV line drops to 0/N. The scenarios ran and only the sampling is wrong: that is an unobserved hole, fixed in the collector, never in the stimulus. Move the call back afterwards.
